hank_bio: Born and raised in the Lowcountry, studying Business and Aviation. Hank believes in doing it right the first time, bringing the same care and precision to every tree as he would to his own home.
jacob_bio: Charleston native and UGA Finance and Real Estate major. Always early to the job, Jacob lives by "slow and steady wins the race," taking the extra time to get every tree perfect.
about_intro:
Hank and Jacob are longtime friends who decided to build something real in their hometown. Born and raised in Charleston, they started with an idea: make the holiday season easier and less stressful for the families and businesses around them. That idea, backed by a strong work ethic and a love for the Christmas season, led to Charleston Tree Concierge.

Hank and Jacob are hands-on with the work, making deliveries themselves alongside their trained local team that shares their standards. There are no subcontractors and no call center, just a crew that cares about doing it right. When you call us, you’re talking to the people who personally deliver your tree.
